name: Ewan Macmillan
connection_to_money_laundering: Offered to help reporters 'clean' dirty cash by buying gold in Zimbabwe and smuggling it to Dubai. Used a network of couriers, fake invoices, and shell companies to hide the origin of proceeds banked in Dubai.
connection_to_political_figures: Claimed direct access to the highest levels of power in Zimbabwe, including President Emmerson Mnangagwa, who he claimed was his 'partner' and to whom he claimed to have access.
